findings.description: The code performs unchecked pointer arithmetic on a, e.g., a+main(...), and dereferences *a while advancing without any bound checks.

K&R/old-style function definition main(t,_,a) with implicit int and no prototype.
Calling a function without a prototype and using default promotions, including passing pointers, is undefined behavior on some ABIs.
Incorrect main signature (standards non-compliance) and implicit int.
